statement.text: Let ''M'' be a matroid on ground set ''V'', let ''H=(V,E)'' be a hypergraph with maximum degree <math>\Delta</math>, let ''c(v)'' be the cost of node ''v'', and let <math>l(e) \leq u(e)</math> (<math>e \in E</math>) be lower and upper bounds on the hyperedges. Let ''OPT'' denote the minimum cost of a basis ''B'' of ''M'' which satisfies <math>l(e) \leq |B \cap e| \leq u(e)</math> for every <math>e \in E</math>. Is there a polynomial algorithm to find a basis ''B'' such that <math>c(B) \leq OPT</math> and <math>l(e)-\Delta+1 \leq |B \cap e| \leq u(e)+\Delta-1</math>?
